command: CRX2RNX.exe -  < in.crx > out.rnx   (in.crx = corpus file after rinexcore.io.compress.unwrap; stdin/stdout redirected to files opened in binary mode by tools/check_hatanaka.py)
platform: Windows 11 x64; the mingw build writes stdout in text mode, so each LF is written as CRLF

fields.crx_sha256: sha256 of the unwrapped CRX bytes fed to stdin
fields.exit_code: CRX2RNX exit code (0 ok, 1 error, 2 warning)
fields.sha256_raw: sha256 of the raw stdout (CRLF line ends)
fields.sha256_lf: sha256 of the raw stdout with every CRLF replaced by LF; our decoder's output (LF) must have this digest
fields.lone_cr: number of CR bytes not followed by LF (0 means sha256_lf is unambiguous)

rinex402_picosec.description: RINEX 4.02 obs with picosecond epoch fields, made by tests/unit/test_hatanaka.py:make_rinex402_fixture(); encoded by rinexcore.io.hatanaka.rnx_to_crx (CRINEX 3.1, program 'rinexcore fixture', date '30-Oct-26 00:00'); crx2rnx = CRX2RNX 4.2.0 run on that CRX
